summary: A sampled run now prints the pass/fail/error split and the distinct reasons behind a non-PASS verdict, instead of the bare word UNSTABLE.
details: MEASURED on the deploy host 2026-09-22: note_candidates p3_follow_up_owed read UNSTABLE at --sample 3 and the report said nothing else. `2 pass / 1 fail` and `1 pass / 2 error` are different facts wearing the same word, and the second is a case that mostly did not RUN -- which rule 3 (ERROR is not FAIL and is never PASS) exists to keep separate.
Asking 'how unstable, and was any draw an error?' previously cost another run of the corpus, at a median 118k input tokens per full turn.
Distinct reasons only: three draws failing the same way is ONE fact, and printing it three times hides that it is.
`evals.backbone.base_name` is public now, since the CLI reads it to group draws back onto their base case.
